integrity_notes: Complete proof is provided; the external positive lifting premise is identified, including its theorem number. Neither numerical experimentation nor inaccessible supporting text is used as an infinite-dimensional proof.
scientific_limitations: The classification applies only to normalized absolute sums of one real scalar coordinate and countable real ell_1.
No claim is made about general equivalent lattice renormings, higher-block sums or general semiprojective Banach lattices.
The quotient-tower construction is adapted from Kania--Niwinski Theorem 6.9; its previous maximum-norm case is explicitly credited.
The exact formula is analytically derived from an explicit witness and a classical ell_1 projectivity theorem. No independent audit or publication-priority certification was performed.
title: Absolute-sum rigidity and exact lattice lifting constants for scalar–\(\ell_1\) extensions
